scope: Selected primary sources and discovery portals. This is not an exhaustive labour-market study or a list of currently open opportunities.

facts: Basic criteria include a relevant degree/enrolment window, programming experience, and data structures, algorithms or object-oriented design.
Project/internship experience, databases, cloud, version control and troubleshooting appear as preferred criteria; communication is also listed.
sources.limit: One role is not a universal employer requirement. Graduation timing and documents must be checked on the live advert.

facts: Programme descriptions include Python/SQL/data pipelines, software development, automated testing, cloud/security and stakeholder collaboration.
sources.limit: These are programme focus areas, not all mandatory entry criteria. Dates on the programme page are indicative; recheck each listing.

facts: Applications use a profile and supporting documents. Selection may include technical exercises, case studies and interviews.
sources.limit: Preparation must not impersonate a candidate during live assessments.

facts: WIL spans engineering and nontechnical fields, including computing, finance and administration.
The page distinguishes WIL, young professional, technician, engineer and apprenticeship programmes.
sources.limit: Programme existence does not establish an open vacancy. WIL recognition and placement requirements need institution/provider confirmation.

facts: Professional registration involves qualifications, practical development, reports and competence assessment.
sources.limit: KAIRO simulation completion cannot confer professional registration.

facts: The framework integrates knowledge, skills, values and behaviours; the qualification process includes education, assessment and workplace training.
The page describes updates approved in February 2026.
sources.limit: Use the current downloadable framework for exact assessment rubrics; KAIRO cannot issue CA(SA) status.

facts: Digital acumen, data analytics, database management, ethical conduct, analysis and decision making are defined competencies.
sources.limit: Post-qualification guidance is not identical to entry-level job eligibility.

facts: The practice guide covers distributed study, worked examples, quizzing and explanatory questions.
sources.limit: Research guidance motivates mechanisms; it does not prove KAIRO outcomes. The live IES landing page was under maintenance.

facts: Clear, systematic teaching and worked examples support explicit instruction.
sources.limit: Adapt and evaluate with South African tertiary learners; do not generalise effect sizes to this app.

facts: Planning, monitoring and evaluating learning and modelling thinking inform self-regulation.
sources.limit: School-oriented evidence needs careful transfer to adult and tertiary contexts.

facts: Publishes student/graduate opportunities including internships, learnerships, apprenticeships and bursaries.
sources.limit: Discovery only until matched to the original provider. Its general contact address is not a CV submission destination.

facts: Organises bursary notices by discipline and links to application guidance.
sources.limit: Verify terms, funding, deadlines and submission destination with the funder; do not copy general statements into a specific bursary decision.

facts: The government notice identifies jobs.gauteng.gov.za and professionaljobscentre.gpg.gov.za for the Nasi iSpani programme.
sources.limit: Historical notice establishes identity, not current openings or deadlines. Revalidate the current official portal.

facts: SA Youth is part of the Presidential Youth Employment Intervention and describes its supporting organisations.
sources.limit: Registration, consent, matching rules and individual opportunities require live review; no app integration completed.

facts: Offers in-person and remote volunteering discovery with location and category filters.
sources.limit: Host acceptance, supervision, expenses, safeguarding and WIL credit are not implied by a listing.

facts: Provides free self-paced employer-designed job simulations with tasks and completion certificates.
sources.limit: Simulation, not employment or an accredited degree. Do not describe completion as a physical internship or reuse proprietary answers.

facts: Lists free learning resources, certification preparation, Applied Skills and eligible student discounts.
sources.limit: Free preparation does not make every certification exam free. Read each current credential page and assessment rules.

facts: Hosts the February 2024 national occupations-in-high-demand report.
sources.limit: Dated sector-level context, not a live vacancy feed or a guarantee of local demand.

facts: Publishes tender opportunities and procurement plans with advertised, awarded, cancelled and closed categories.
sources.limit: Parse tender-specific documents, amendments, delivery capacity and requirements. Do not use a UAT portal or automatically submit binding bids.

facts: Describes CSD as a source of supplier information intended to reduce duplicated government supplier information.
sources.limit: CSD registration alone is not tender eligibility or an award. Use current CSD and tender documents.

facts: Describes the October 2024 combination of Seda, Sefa and CBDA into Sedfa.
sources.limit: The current public Sedfa site timed out; service forms, funding eligibility and portal identity remain to verify. Do not recommend a similarly branded development portal.

facts: Free character rig with bundled scripts, credit requirement and Blender source file.
sources.limit: Downloaded is not web-converted or runtime-accepted. Inspect embedded scripts with auto-execution disabled before use.

facts: MPFB code is GPL and core graphical assets are CC0.
sources.limit: Third-party clothes/hair/skins may have separate licences.

facts: Humanoid base characters with CC0 licensing and compatible animation library; pack tiers differ.
sources.limit: A body rig does not establish facial speech controls. Only specific downloaded archive contents may be claimed available.

facts: Publishes humanoid motion clips under CC0, with free and source tiers.
sources.limit: Retarget and inspect individual clips; gesture libraries are not SASL.

facts: Lists CC0 Human Base Meshes and a CC-BY Ellie pose bundle.
sources.limit: Some URLs return a download landing page; integrity must be checked before calling a file an archive.

facts: Selected HDRI lighting files have provider metadata and local checksums in assets.json.
sources.limit: An HDRI is lighting/background imagery, not a walkable environment.

facts: Relevant final-year BSc/Commerce fields, academic results/transcript, analysis and customer/team delivery appear in the advert.
sources.limit: Closed: stated deadline 2026-08-31. Historical preparation only; not an open opportunity.

facts: Describes data flows, data quality, root-cause analysis and stakeholder work.
sources.limit: Indexed closing date 2026-04-28; historical role evidence, not a graduate vacancy.

facts: Describes eliciting and validating business requirements and translating them into solution requirements.
sources.limit: Primary search excerpt verified; full requirements and current availability not established.

facts: Graduate programme context includes projects, communication, business writing and stakeholder work.
sources.limit: Programme context/diaries, not a current open vacancy or universal mandatory criteria.

facts: Supports embedding and controlling a YouTube player.
sources.limit: Provider playback, identity, attribution and embed restrictions still apply.

facts: API access is scoped by product and permission.
sources.limit: Sign-in permissions are not general profile editing, recruitment or job application access.

facts: Tutorial includes tables, queries, joins and aggregation.
sources.limit: Learning resource; content does not independently establish workplace competence.

facts: Redirects to GitHub Learn.
sources.limit: Check current courses, account needs and access before assigning.

unresolved.resolution: Use the separately verified Gauteng programme identity; do not assume this spelling is official.
No reliable identity established. Excluded from automatic ingestion and personal-data submission.
The job-simulation service checked was theforage.com.
Do not assert a specific Siemens requirement from generic industry expectations.
